summary: The costed-close export loop now retains its native filesystem worker through repeated cancellation using the shared owned-thread primitive. The runtime supervisor cancels admitted children once and shields their join, so later parent cancellations cannot interrupt a child's already-running cleanup or release the runtime while native export IO is still active. It collects named coroutine inputs before admission, closes unsubmitted coroutines on producer/task-creation failure and drains all created tasks. Original critical return/error/cancellation behavior remains explicit after cleanup; repeated parent cancellation is propagated only after the join. A native runtime reproduction previously published stopped while the isolated export worker was unfinished; the fixed path withholds stopped until that worker completes. No buy filter, 0.1 SOL sizing, financial outcome validator, exit policy, model fitting/activation or operator history is changed. Original closed-source paths in the working root are absent, so no additional operator net-learning export is manufactured from them. All operational processes stay off. Full strategy/provider/financial/profitability acceptance remains incomplete.

reproduction.authoritative_baseline: Three native failing cases: export task ends while its admitted thread is live; supervisor interrupts sibling cleanup after a second cancel; actual _runner publishes stopped before isolated export IO completes
reproduction.original_code: run_export_loop awaited an unshielded gather during cancellation; supervise also awaited an unshielded gather of children. Repeated cancellation could propagate into those cleanup waits
reproduction.qualification: Controlled synthetic IO and actual native runtime functions. Not an established historical no-buy or financial-loss cause

contract.export_owner: No export before readiness. Exactly one admitted off-loop repair call at a time. On cancellation, wait for that same worker, consume late worker errors and propagate caller cancellation without a false result callback
contract.supervisor: Critical-loop exit cancels siblings once; later parent cancellation does not recancel their cleanup. Drain every admitted child before returning or raising
contract.startup: Close captured unsubmitted coroutines after producer, malformed admission or task-creation failure, and consume/drain created tasks before propagating the source failure
contract.latency: No forceful thread termination or hardware/filesystem completion SLA is claimed. Waiting for real admitted IO may exceed a nominal shutdown deadline
contract.financial_boundary: Existing immutable original close, costs/FX/T0, guarded export deduplication and native net-return validation remain unchanged. No legacy SQL or gross shadow row is promoted into an original financial source
contract.operator_source_scope: Presence checks cover the actual native D-working-root archive/export/journal/portfolio paths only; absence is not a universal assertion that no trade occurred elsewhere
